services.name: functions
services.purpose: Host scrapbook-api Azure Functions v4 (HTTP + Queue triggers). Node 20.

services.name: staticWebApp
services.purpose: Host scrapbook-web React SPA (static Vite build). Free tier CDN.

services.name: storageAccount
services.purpose: AzureWebJobsStorage + Blob container 'photos' + Queue 'caption-jobs' + Flex Consumption deployment package.

services.name: postgresFlexibleServer
services.purpose: Application relational DB (users, pairings, photos, captions).

services.name: azureOpenAI
services.purpose: Cognitive Services account hosting gpt-4o-mini deployment for caption generation.

services.name: keyVault
services.purpose: Store AUTH_SIGNING_KEY, DB admin password, and any operator-set secrets. Function App reads via managed identity.

services.name: userAssignedIdentity
services.purpose: Managed identity for the Function App to access Storage, Key Vault, Postgres AAD auth (optional), and Azure OpenAI without secrets.

services.name: logAnalyticsWorkspace
services.purpose: Backing workspace for Application Insights and platform diagnostics.

services.name: applicationInsights
services.purpose: APM + telemetry for Function App (already configured in host.json).

Included storage + free backup up to server size.

costEstimate.disclaimer: Estimates based on public Azure retail pricing snapshot for eastus2 at plan time. MCP pricing tool unavailable in this session — figures are best-effort from documented rates. Actual cost varies with traffic, storage growth, and OpenAI token volume. Review https://azure.microsoft.com/pricing/calculator for authoritative numbers.

rejectedAlternatives.reason: The API is an Azure Functions v4 project — Functions Flex Consumption is the native, cheaper (scale-to-zero) fit.
Existing schema uses PostgreSQL-specific types (uuid, timestamptz, gen_random_uuid); migrating dialects would violate deploy-as-is.
App requires relational joins + unique constraints on pairings; NoSQL rework rejected.
No Dockerfile present; the app builds to Functions runtime — no need for container hosting.
App already uses @azure/storage-queue with a documented queue trigger; Storage Queue keeps the free tier + zero code change.
Free tier meets low-traffic demo requirements; can upgrade later without redeploy.

assumptions: MCP quota + pricing tools not available in this session; quota validation is best-effort (region availability confirmed via `az provider show` and `az cognitiveservices model list`, but per-subscription quota was NOT confirmed).
OpenAI content-generation is optional at runtime (isConfigured flag) — if OpenAI provisioning fails, the app deploys with caption features disabled rather than blocking the whole rollout.
PostgreSQL admin password will be auto-generated at deploy time and stored in Key Vault (never surfaced to the user).
AUTH_SIGNING_KEY will be auto-generated (64-byte hex) at deploy time and stored in Key Vault (never surfaced to the user).
Static Web App is provisioned separately from Functions (BYO backend model) with CORS on the Function App locked to the SWA hostname.
Region eastus2 chosen for its combined support for Postgres Flex + Azure OpenAI + Functions Flex Consumption; fallback to eastus if quota healing needed.

postDeployRecommendations.title: Rotate AUTH_SIGNING_KEY periodically via Key Vault
postDeployRecommendations.reason: Reduce blast radius of a leaked signing key.

postDeployRecommendations.title: Enable Application Insights availability tests against /api/health
Extend PostgreSQL PITR retention and enable geo-redundant backup
postDeployRecommendations.reason: Default 7-day PITR is thin for production data.

postDeployRecommendations.title: Upgrade Static Web Apps to Standard for staging environments + private endpoints
postDeployRecommendations.reason: Free tier lacks staging slots and private networking.

postDeployRecommendations.title: Move Postgres to VNet + private endpoint
postDeployRecommendations.reason: Public network access with firewall is convenient but not defense-in-depth.
